title: The Kindness Quest
subtitle: Be the kind kid who makes the day better
description: A new kid joins your class and looks lonely. Choose how you'll help them feel welcome.
learning_objectives: Recognize when a peer is feeling left out
Understand that kindness is a choice
reflection_prompt: When was the last time someone was kind to you when you were feeling left out? What did they do?

scenes.title: A New Kid
scenes.narration: There's a new kid in your class. They sit alone at lunch. Their tray is empty.

choices.label: Sit with them and share your snack

scenes.narration: You sit down. They smile. You share your apple slices. They tell you their name — Mira.

choices.label: Ask Mira about her old school
Invite Mira to play tag at recess

scenes.narration: Mira waves back, but stays at her table. She still looks lonely.

choices.label: Tell your friends about the new kid

scenes.narration: Mira ate alone. The next day she stays quiet too.

choices.label: Try again today — go say hi

scenes.narration: By Friday, Mira laughs with you at recess. She saved you a seat.
scenes.outcome_summary: You made a new friend by being kind first. That's a superpower.

scenes.narration: Your friends are curious. At recess you all wave Mira over and she joins.
scenes.outcome_summary: You used your group to include someone. That's leadership.

scenes.narration: Mira eventually finds other friends, but she remembers the week she ate alone.
scenes.outcome_summary: It's not too late next time. Kindness is always a choice.
